name: Like a Book (Sp)
body:
Prerequisite: Saboteur 4

Benefit: The saboteur can quickly use magic to gain insight over a creature. When she marks a target with her informant’s mark, she can gain one of the following effects: detect chaos, detect evil, detect good, detect law, detect thoughts, or discern next of kin. The saboteur gains the benefits of that divination effect so long as the target is marked, but only against the marked target and any items it is carrying or using. She does not have to concentrate to maintain the effect.
